card.title: STURM-BRIGADE RHODOS
card.text: If in your hand, this unit costs 2 less each time your countermeasure triggers.
card.flavorText: Sturm-Brigade Rhodos was an assault brigade of the German Wehrmacht which was formed from elements of the 22nd Infantry Division. The brigade included four infantry companies and an anti-tank company. In 1943 the brigade was reformed into the Grenadier Regiment Rhodos as part of Assault Division Rhodos, but the regiment was destroyed near Belgrade in Yugoslavia in 1944, and the remaining soldiers were moved to the Panzergrenadier Division Brandenburg which were the German special forces during WWII.
